literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) describes a full-length, membrane-anchored mouse GPNMB construct named 'pCAGIP-mouse GPNMB-FLAG/HA'. Two disqualifying problems prevent it from grounding any extracellular tag site. First, the construct name follows the standard 'Protein-Tag' C-terminal convention; GPNMB is a type I single-pass protein whose C-terminus (residues 519–572) is intracellular, so the FLAG/HA tag almost certainly faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space. Second, and independently, the clip explicitly states the plasmid 'has been described previously' — the tag position is not stated in this clip, only in a prior paper that is outside the ledger. Per the rules, a plasmid whose tag position is unstated cannot be used to pin insert_after_residue, and topology_derived cannot rescue it because the construct naming contradicts an N-terminal placement. No other ledger lines exist. Therefore zero extracellular surface tag sites are supported.
